rules: Follow the feature specification exactly unless the user explicitly overrides it.
Modify existing files when appropriate; create new files when needed.
After implementing changes, always run './gradlew assembleDebug'.
If the build fails, fix the errors and rebuild until successful.
After a successful build, run 'adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'.
After installation, run 'adb logcat' and monitor for crashes or incorrect behaviour.
When the user describes issues or incorrect behaviour, refine the implementation and repeat the loop.
All code must remain consistent with the project's architecture and conventions.
Never invent features; always follow the spec.
Ask for clarification only when the spec is ambiguous.
